causal_limit: No equal-information operational baseline is implemented; ordinary memory plus the same model could explain an adaptive result. No causal advantage or general reliability claim.
failure_conditions: treating fictional condition assertions as observed program outcomes
recording a relation without later using it while claiming adaptive pursuit
claiming wording change alone as relational development
manually steering a later action or supplying a replacement solution
repeating a defeated approach without an evidence-grounded reason
legitimate_unexercised: justified retention or no new relationship
primary: Does independently reviewed, model-developed understanding of the parents use actual program return to inform a subsequent freely proposed pursuit?
separate_outcomes: reviewed return-informed relationship retention or development
substantive subsequent use of reviewed meaning
cost, corrections, assistance and unknown effects
